source_en: Oh! A new face! First day, yes? I can always tell, wide eyes. I love wide eyes!
Ivan Tarkov. Factory worker. Third block. Same time, same smile every evening. Reliable as a clock!
The officer before you, very sharp. Very dedicated. Then one day he just... stopped showing up. These things happen, I suppose!
Do you enjoy meeting people in this work? I think it's the best part!
Give it time. Every face becomes memorable. Some more than others. Naturally.
Yes! And the best part, they never notice when someone's paying very close attention. Ha!
You should smile more. A smile makes even the most guarded person feel at ease. Wonderful tool.
But you have work to do. Here are my papers. Everything in order, as always. I am a very tidy person.
